description: Edit a Chat message's content and/or mark it resolved (ClickUp Chat v3). Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated message.

content.description: New message body. Omit to keep current.

message_id.description: ID of the message to edit.

resolved.description: Set true to mark the message resolved, false to reopen it.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: update_chat_message
